benefit: Your child's school day, clear at a glance
steps: Sign in with your TAMO account. Open today. Ask what's due.
facts: Free · iPhone and iPad · Runs in the free Scriptable app · Needs a TAMO dienynas parent account · In English and Lithuanian · AI is optional, with your own Claude or OpenAI key
bannerAlt: Dienynas+: Messages. Homework. Calm. Your child's TAMO dienynas goes in, today's lessons, homework and messages come out on one page. Two iPhone screens show today and an AI answer, with a week strip where the selected day has a blue plus.
